info.name: Inworld Models Text To Speech API

items.docs: Synthesize a single audio response from text. Returns base64-encoded audio plus optional word/character/phoneme alignment metadata. Maximum 2,000 input characters per request and 16 MB output audio.
Stream synthesis. The response is a chunked sequence of JSON envelopes, each containing a base64 audio fragment. Use for low-latency playback of long-form text.

Upgrade to a WebSocket connection for bidirectional streaming synthesis. Clients send `SynthesizeRequest` frames and receive chunked audio frames with timestamp metadata. Auth via `Authorization: Basic` header on the upgrade request.

params.name: filter
params.description: Optional filter expression (e.g. by tag, language, gender).

items.docs: List voices available for synthesis. Includes Inworld-shipped voices and any custom-cloned or designed voices in the caller's workspace.
